name: g10-12.13.03-search-date-patient
title: 12.13.03 Server returns valid results for Encounter search by date + patient
description: g10 12.13.03 (SH-PAT-2; US Core 6.1.0: group 10.13). Server returns valid results for Encounter search by date + patient. US Core SHALL search. Every result must match every parameter, and the record's Encounter/g10-example-1 must be among them.

assert.description: Every Encounter returned matches the search

test.name: Comparator gt: GET Encounter?date=gt2015-10-31T22:00:14Z&patient=g10-example
test.description: Every result's date satisfies gt (compared by day). As in Inferno, no result is required.

assert.description: Every Encounter returned matches the search
assert.expression: Bundle.entry.resource.ofType(Encounter).all((subject.reference.endsWith('Patient/g10-example')) and (period.ofType(dateTime).where($this.toString().substring(0, 10) >= '2015-10-31').exists() or period.ofType(instant).where($this.toString().substring(0, 10) >= '2015-10-31').exists() or period.ofType(date).where($this.toString().substring(0, 10) >= '2015-10-31').exists() or period.ofType(Period).where(end.empty() or end.where($this.toString().substring(0, 10) >= '2015-10-31').exists()).exists()))
